title: Incorrect supply usage
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The contract uses the global variable `supply` in some places, and the function value `totalSupply` in other places. The issue is that these two values are not the same.  `totalSupply` is the total minted out LP tokens in circulation.  `supply` is a value calculated using Newton-Raphson iterations based on the weights, sums and products of the tokens composing the pool.  These two values are only in sync after calling the `_calculateSupply` followed by `_updateSupply`, since the latter function burns or mints the LP token s
